patterns.note: The page uses a centered, single-column content layout, presenting information in distinct blocks that alternate between text-heavy descriptions and smaller embedded visual examples.
A high-contrast dark mode theme is used throughout, featuring light text on a deep charcoal background, accented by a single bright yellow for the brand logo and key highlights.
A clean, rounded sans-serif typeface is consistently applied across all text elements, providing excellent readability and a modern, friendly feel on the dark background.
Content sections reveal by scrolling up into the viewport as the user progresses down the page, creating a sequential, static flow without complex animations or sticky elements.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep charcoal background and light grey text for high contrast. A single vibrant yellow is used sparingly for branding and emphasis. Content is presented in a single, centered column, with feature sections clearly delineated by headings and accompanying small visual examples. As the user scrolls, new content blocks simply slide up into the viewport, maintaining a straightforward, sequential reveal without any parallax, sticky elements, or complex fade/slide animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining a consistent, clean sans-serif character for both.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to UI elements within mockups and the App Store badge, contributing to a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced vertical spacing between content blocks, with a more generous initial vertical rhythm in the hero section.

standout: The site's standout feature is its confident and consistent dark mode aesthetic, which feels both minimal and premium. The design effectively uses a single, bright accent color (yellow) against a deep charcoal background to highlight branding and key information, creating a strong visual identity without being overly busy.
